notes: Shopify store (brostecopenhagen-com.myshopify.com, theme 'Sleek'). Direct fetch worked throughout (no WAF bypass needed for content pages), though the origin intermittently served a Cloudflare 'Verifying your connection' JS-challenge / HTTP 429 under request bursts from the requests-based probe.py session -- resolved by pacing and switching to plain curl requests, which succeeded immediately. robots.txt itself repeatedly returned the Cloudflare challenge page (could not read its rules text), but no Claude-specific block was observed on any actual content page fetched. TAXONOMY: category/qty data comes from the Shopify Search & Discovery 'Category' facet (filter.p.m.perfion.category) on each of the 9 top-nav collections (Tableware, Kitchen, Candles, Home decor, Seasonal decor, Textiles, Lighting, Furniture, Outdoor living) -- a PIM-driven product-type attribute, not a marketing facet. Facet-sidebar counts were spot-verified against the live filtered-page '<n> of <total> products' header and/or full product-ID-exhaustion counts for a representative sample spanning small/medium/large values (Bowls=37, Vases=118, Tapered Candles=133, Christmas Ornaments=108, Candle Holders=94 exhaustion-counted across 4 pages) -- all exact matches, no inflation found; this gave confidence to trust the remaining facet-sidebar counts without re-fetching every one individually. CROSS-LISTING (Rule 0.6): many product-type labels repeat verbatim across multiple top-nav collections with IDENTICAL or SUBSET product-ID sets (confirmed via direct ID comparison) -- e.g. 'Floor Vases' appears under Home decor (5, superset), Seasonal decor (5, identical set) and Outdoor living (3, subset); 'Candle Holders', 'Lanterns', 'Flowerpots with Stand', 'Planters', 'Sculpture Candles', 'Tapered Candles' show the same pattern. These are the exact same products cross-listed under a second/third URL, so each was counted ONCE (under its superset collection) rather than padded by summing duplicate listings. The 'Seasonal decor' and 'Outdoor living' nav collections were found to consist ENTIRELY of (a) Christmas/holiday-themed items (excluded per the brief's Holiday & Gift exclusion: Christmas, Christmas Candles, Christmas Ornaments, Christmas Table Decoration, Christmas Textiles, 'Julepynt') or (b) furniture (Seating, Tables, Pedestals/'Rillo Podium' -- excluded) or (c) verified duplicates of items already counted under Home decor / Candles above -- so neither collection contributes any new in-scope rows on its own. DANISH-TAG ANOMALY: the site's PIM (Perfion) has several category values that exist ONLY in Danish with no English equivalent applied to those specific products -- these are NOT duplicates of their nearest English-labelled category: 'Servietringe' (4, vs 'Napkin Rings' 5), 'Lysestager' (17, vs 'Candle Holders' 94), 'Fyrfadsstager' (2, vs 'Tealight Holders' 5), and 'Lanterner' (1, vs 'Lanterns' 13) were all product-ID-verified as fully NON-overlapping, additive sets. 'Kroge & Bojler' (8, vs 'Hooks and Coat Hangers' 5) fits the same pattern by label but its own overlap check was blocked by a repeated Cloudflare challenge specific to that URL -- flagged MANUAL REVIEW, non-overlap inferred by analogy with the other 4 confirmed cases, not directly confirmed. All five alt-tag rows are kept as separate leaf rows (translated label + parenthetical note of the Danish tag) rather than silently merged into the English-tag row, to preserve exactness (Rule 1) since no verified combined total exists on the site itself. SCOPE DECISIONS: Kitchen collection almost entirely excluded (cookware/cutlery/storage/textiles: Chopping Board & Rolling Pins, Ovenware, Dish Cloths, Tea Towels, Kitchen Storage, Grinder & Mortars, Trivets, Salad Serving Sets, wine-cooler tag). Tableware collection: cutlery (Cake Forks, Cutlery Sets, Forks, Knives, Long Spoons, Spoons, Teaspoon(s)) and textiles (Napkins, Paper Napkins, Tablecloths, Placemats/Runners/Coasters) excluded. Home Textiles and Furniture nav collections excluded wholesale per brief. 'Fans' (5, home-decor) confirmed via product titles ('Saba Fan', 'Ibi Fan') to be decorative wall/hand fans, not electric appliances -- included. Generic 'Accessories' facet (25, home-decor) inspected by title (Deco Plates, Dishes, Trays, Deco egg, Pedestal) and found to be a genuine, non-duplicate decor-item set -- included rather than dropped as a roll-up. 'Cords' (lighting, wiring hardware) and generic Danish 'Fyrfadsstager'-adjacent bar-tool tag excluded per brief.
